capture_policies_target_check.name: capture_policies_target_check
capture_policies_target_check.value:
("capture_policies"."target_type" = 'global' and "capture_policies"."project_id" is null and "capture_policies"."thread_id" is null)
        or ("capture_policies"."target_type" = 'project' and "capture_policies"."project_id" is not null and "capture_policies"."thread_id" is null)
        or ("capture_policies"."target_type" = 'thread' and "capture_policies"."thread_id" is not null)

device_credentials_verifier_shape_check.name: device_credentials_verifier_shape_check
device_credentials_verifier_shape_check.value:
(
        "device_credentials"."verifier_kind" = 'secret_hash'
        and "device_credentials"."verifier_hash" is not null
        and "device_credentials"."public_key_jwk" is null
      ) or (
        "device_credentials"."verifier_kind" = 'public_key_jwk'
        and "device_credentials"."public_key_jwk" is not null
        and "device_credentials"."verifier_hash" is null
      )

encrypted_field_payloads_scope_owner_che.name: encrypted_field_payloads_scope_owner_check
encrypted_field_payloads_scope_owner_che.value:
(
        "encrypted_field_payloads"."encryption_scope" = 'personal'
        and "encrypted_field_payloads"."visibility" = 'personal'
        and "encrypted_field_payloads"."owner_user_id" is not null
        and "encrypted_field_payloads"."team_id" is null
        and "encrypted_field_payloads"."team_workspace_id" is null
      ) or (
        "encrypted_field_payloads"."encryption_scope" = 'team'
        and "encrypted_field_payloads"."visibility" = 'personal'
        and "encrypted_field_payloads"."team_id" is not null
      )

memory_embeddings_unique_active_node_chu.name: memory_embeddings_unique_active_node_chunk
memory_embeddings_unique_active_node_chu.where: "memory_embeddings"."invalidated_at" is null and "memory_embeddings"."memory_node_id" is not null

memory_embeddings_unique_active_event_ch.name: memory_embeddings_unique_active_event_chunk
memory_embeddings_unique_active_event_ch.where: "memory_embeddings"."invalidated_at" is null and "memory_embeddings"."memory_event_id" is not null

memory_embeddings_unique_active_message_.name: memory_embeddings_unique_active_message_chunk
memory_embeddings_unique_active_message_.where: "memory_embeddings"."invalidated_at" is null and "memory_embeddings"."message_id" is not null

memory_node_sources_one_source_check.name: memory_node_sources_one_source_check
memory_node_sources_one_source_check.value: "memory_node_sources"."memory_event_id" is not null or "memory_node_sources"."message_id" is not null or "memory_node_sources"."tool_event_id" is not null

memory_nodes_personal_pinned_idx.name: memory_nodes_personal_pinned_idx
memory_nodes_personal_pinned_idx.where: "memory_nodes"."visibility" = 'personal' and "memory_nodes"."invalidated_at" is null and "memory_nodes"."pinned_at" is not null

memory_questions_search_domain_check.name: memory_questions_search_domain_check
memory_questions_search_domain_check.value:
("memory_questions"."search_domain" = 'global')
        or ("memory_questions"."search_domain" = 'project' and "memory_questions"."workspace_id" is not null)
        or ("memory_questions"."search_domain" = 'session' and "memory_questions"."session_id" is not null)

memory_questions_status_check.name: memory_questions_status_check
memory_questions_status_check.value:
("memory_questions"."status" = 'answered' and "memory_questions"."answer_markdown" is not null and "memory_questions"."error_message" is null)
        or ("memory_questions"."status" = 'error' and "memory_questions"."error_message" is not null)
        or "memory_questions"."status" = 'pending'

sync_package_upload_sessions_counts_chec.name: sync_package_upload_sessions_counts_check
sync_package_upload_sessions_counts_chec.value:
"sync_package_upload_sessions"."package_format_version" > 0
        and "sync_package_upload_sessions"."total_bytes" >= 0
        and "sync_package_upload_sessions"."uploaded_bytes" >= 0
        and "sync_package_upload_sessions"."uploaded_bytes" <= "sync_package_upload_sessions"."total_bytes"
        and "sync_package_upload_sessions"."chunk_count" >= 0
        and "sync_package_upload_sessions"."verified_chunk_count" >= 0
        and "sync_package_upload_sessions"."verified_chunk_count" <= "sync_package_upload_sessions"."chunk_count"

team_session_share_grants_active_unique.name: team_session_share_grants_active_unique
team_session_share_grants_active_unique.where: "team_session_share_grants"."session_id" is not null and "team_session_share_grants"."revoked_at" is null
